summary: Reggaeton: 88-100 BPM dembow (a steady four-on-the-floor kick under a 3-3-2 snare and rim), tight drum-machine sounds with maracas/güira and timbales, a short sub/808 bass on the roots, minor three- or four-chord loops (i-VI-III-VII), a plucked, guitar or marimba hook; knowledge/style/reggaeton.json is its template
body: Tempo 88-100 BPM, modern hits 92-96 (90 to start; some newer tracks 100-110). Dominican dembow is a faster cousin at 115-130.

Drums: the dembow, a 2-beat cell repeated: kick on every quarter, snare or rim on the 4th and 7th 16ths of each half bar (steps 4, 7, 12, 15: the 3-3-2 against the kick), hats in 8ths or quarters; the kick tight and short and mid-forward, the snare boxy (200-400 Hz), bright and cutting, often layered with a clap; maracas or güira, congas or bongos, timbale fills at phrase ends; extra ghost 16th snares for movement.
Bass: a deep sine sub or short 808 on the chord roots, landing with the kick, mostly staccato (shorter than trap's), the occasional slide; high-pass the kick and sub against each other.
Harmony: simple and usually minor: three or four chords looping (i-VI-III-VII, or a two-chord vamp), a synth pad or synth strings held low under the beat, often filtered.
Lead: a short 2-4 bar motif repeated: a plucked synth, nylon or flamenco guitar, marimba or a piano stab; harpsichord, sitar or classical guitar with heavy delay in intros. Leave room for the vocal.

Texture/master: loud and uncluttered: dry, punchy drums with the snare cutting through, kick and sub loud but controlled, percussion crisp and wide; wet delays and reverbs only in intros and breakdowns.

Sources (2026-11-26): Native Instruments 'How to make reggaeton'; MusicRadar '22 essential reggaeton production tips to help you sound like Bad Bunny'; Violet Recording 'How to make reggaeton beats'; Wikipedia 'Dembow beat'.

Apply: pattern/gmd-latin-reggaeton-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/minor-i-vi-iii-vii on the keys four bars later. For a whole style change the Team Lead's restyle uses knowledge/style/reggaeton.json instead.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
